main.description: Remove an account from a space's writer set. A removed account can be re-added to the writer set later if they make an authorized write to the space. Requires auth with a covering manage=update grant, implemented by a space host.

space.description: Permissioned space URI, in the form at://{authority}/space/{spaceType}/{skey}. Not a standard at-uri.

did.description: The DID of the writer to remove.
